title: registry/<slug>.yaml
description: Andre's half of a game: where it is served, who may change it, and what the platform does for it. Only the platform repository's owners can merge these.

slug.description: Must match the file name. Names the game in netlog, the relay and the screenshot.

kind.description: pages: built from `repo` by the shared workflow and served by GitHub Pages. external: served from somewhere else; the platform only guards and lists it.

owners.description: GitHub logins who maintain the game. Informational, and used for CODEOWNERS in the game repo.

manifest.description: A game.yaml kept here, for a game whose repository has none yet or for an external game. A game.yaml in the repository replaces it.

enabled.description: Andre's switch. false takes the game off the hub, stops its deploys and makes the guard show it as offline.

guard.description: The games-guard Worker sits in front of the host.

byAndre.description: true credits Andre by default. false requires the manifest to name its author.

origin.description: Attribution class used by the guard's pages and llms.txt.

image.description: The screenshot's file name at the hub root. Defaults to <slug>.png.

crawlerFiles.description: The guard generates robots.txt and sitemap.xml for the host. Leave false when the game ships its own.

netlog.description: The game's relay may report finished matches to games-guard.

relay.description: Present when the game has a relay. Without it, a relay in game.yaml is refused.

managed.description: true: the platform deploys it from game.yaml. false: it exists but is still deployed by hand.

worker.description: The Worker's name. Defaults to <slug>-relay. Never rename a deployed relay: its Durable Objects belong to the name.

domain.description: Its custom domain. Defaults to <slug>-relay.<zone>; null means workers.dev only.

workersDev.description: Keep the workers.dev address too. Defaults to true only when there is no custom domain; set it for a relay whose clients still call workers.dev.
